newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PAL settles row with World Airways.
newsitem.headline: PAL settles row with World Airways.

text.p: Philippine Airlines (PAL) said on Saturday it had reached an amicable settlement with World Airways Inc after withholding the lease payment for its four aircrafts last week.

"World Airways committed to PAL to exert more effort to improve its on-time reliability...PAL, on the other hand, committed to continue with the wet-lease under a restructured agreement," PAL said in a statement.
PAL officials declined to give the specifics of the restructured agreement.
PAL is leasing four MD-11s of World Airways for its regional and long-haul international flights.
The World Airways aircrafts are being used pending the delivery of 17 new ones for PAL. The three-year lease is set to expire next year.
PAL earlier complained that World Airways was not able to provide ample support service for the aircraft.
The wet-lease agreement covers techical support, such as providing spare parts and mechanic services, for the planes.
